Count internal or built-in objects by kind with optional filtering.

By default, counts only internal or built-in objects (excludes regular public objects).
For total system object count (all objects), use 'zqk.test object count' instead.

When no kind is specified, counts all internal/built-in object kinds.
By default, kinds with 0 objects are omitted to reduce noise; use --include-zero-count to include them.
When a single kind is specified, counts objects of that kind.
When multiple kinds are specified (comma-separated), counts each kind.

Use --built-in to filter for only built-in instances.
Use --internal to filter for only internal objects (visibility: internal).
Use --all to count all objects including regular public ones (same scope as 'object count').

This command respects the 'countable' trait - only objects with this trait can be counted.
Use 'zqk.test internal <kind> fields' to see which traits are available for a kind.

Examples:
  # Count all internal/built-in object kinds
  zqk.test internal count

  # Count a single kind
  zqk.test internal count test_audit_aggregation_metric

  # Count multiple kinds (comma-separated)
  zqk.test internal count audit_event,change_journal_entry

  # Count with filtering
  zqk.test internal count test_audit_aggregation_metric --filter event_count=20

  # Count with multiple filters
  zqk.test internal count test_audit_aggregation_metric --filter event_count=20 --filter status=active

  # Count grouped by field
  zqk.test internal count test_audit_aggregation_metric --group-by event_count

  # Count only built-in objects
  zqk.test internal count component --built-in

  # Count only internal objects
  zqk.test internal count object_spec --internal

  # Count all objects (including regular public ones)
  zqk.test internal count backlog_item --all

  # Include kinds with 0 objects (e.g. to spot kinds that should have data)
  zqk.test internal count --include-zero-count

Usage:
  zqk.test internal count [kind|kinds...] [flags]

Flags:
      --all                     Count all objects (including regular public objects)
      --built-in                Filter for built-in instances only
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --filter stringArray      Filter by field (format: field=value or field:value, can be used multiple times)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --group-by string         Field to group counts by (returns count per group)
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --include-zero-count      Include kinds with 0 objects (default omits them to reduce noise)
      --internal                Filter for internal objects (visibility: internal) only
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
